text:
maria_cs: Morning — Vanguard's Dedicated flip is scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Main asks: (1) confirm quota reservations + reserve pool assignment, (2) autoscale policy to match expected traffic, (3) warmup/priming plan and load tests, (4) IP allowlist / firewall rules, (5) rollback plan and oncall. Who can own which?

devon_sre: I can own the load tests and warmup. Need QPS profile and target LAT/SLA. Also will run the priming script against the reserved pool.

sam_eng: From engineering notes: Vanguard will pin to model-tag v1.3-quant. Embedding-heavy. Recommend autoscale min_instances=2, target_util=65%, max_instances=30, burst_capacity=40 for first 24h. Also enable prefix KV caching for chat endpoints.

alina_pm: Vanguard provided traffic forecast: peak burst 2k rps for 5–10m, sustained 600 rps. Latency target <=120ms p50, <=250ms p95. Renewal sensitivity: they flagged 200ms p95 as a redline. We should keep the first-week safety margin.

maria_cs: thanks. devon, if you can share the load script details I can loop in customer's SRE. Also confirming: is there an IP allowlist for their egress? Ticket #IN-4572 has their CIDR blocks.

devon_sre: load script attached below — it's a lightweight k6 profile that simulates embedding + chat mix. Will run soak and short bursts. Command:

```
# priming + quick burst
./run_loadtest.sh --target 2000 --duration 10m --mix embedding:0.6,chat:0.4 --pool reserved-vanguard
# priming requests
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests -d @priming_payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Also note: before load we should pre-warm prefixes with the priming_payload.json to populate KV cache and shards.

sam_eng: ops checklist update: 1) quota reservation: set reserved_pool=rp-vanguard (done), 2) model pin: v1.3-quant (done), 3) autoscale policy: draft pushed to infra-config repo, tag: vanguard-autoscale-2001, 4) observability: enable detailed traces + token-level cost on the route, 5) fallback rules: route->small-variant if latency spikes and capacity exhausted.

maria_cs: I'll schedule a 30m readiness call 30m before flip with Vanguard SRE + our oncall. devon, can you share a quick pass/fail checklist for the load run? I want clear go/no-go criteria.

devon_sre: pass/fail criteria:
- soak for 30m at sustained 600 rps with p95 < 250ms
- 2x burst test to 2k rps with no errors > 1%
- KV cache hit rate > 70% after priming
- no OOM or kernel errors in infra logs

maria_cs: perfect. Can someone confirm firewall ingress so their test agents can reach the reserved pool endpoints? They will run from three IPs.

sam_eng: confirmed — added their three CIDRs to allowlist and updated ticket IN-4572. Also added a note to infra: set instance warmup grace to 90s to avoid chasing cold starts.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy v1.3-quant to rp-vanguard completed — 4/4 instances healthy :white_check_mark:

alina_pm: quick ask — can we enable a conservative cost cap alert to notify finance if token cost > 1.5x estimate during the first 48h?

maria_cs: yes, I'll enable a watch and tag finance. Also adding an enablement doc link for Vanguard SRE to the ticket.

sam_eng: one more thing — during the first 6 hours set autoscale cooldown to 45s and rapid scale down disabled to avoid flapping.

maria_cs: owners: devon -> loadtests & priming, sam -> infra autoscale config, alina -> customer comms & SLAs, me -> kickoff call + finance watch. I'll post minutes and attach the runbook here.

maria_cs: Final thumbs? :thumbsup:

devon_sre: :thumbsup:

sam_eng: +1

alina_pm: +1

maria_cs: Ok moving to execution. I'll update ticket IN-4572 with runbook and call link.
